items.glossEn: anger(-gry), [phrase] before, countenance, face, [phrase] forebearing, forehead, [phrase] (long-) suffering, nose, nostril, snout, [idiom] worthy, wrath.
items.defEn: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire

items.glossEn: (small) cattle, flock ([phrase] -s), lamb ([phrase] -s), sheep(-cote, -fold, -shearer, -herds).
items.defEn: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)

items.glossEn: Pharaoh.
items.defEn: Paroh, a general title of Egyptian kings

items.glossEn: [phrase] carbuncle, [phrase] mason, [phrase] plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-) stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s).
items.defEn: a stone

items.glossEn: body, (fat, lean) flesh(-ed), kin, (man-) kind, [phrase] nakedness, self, skin.
items.defEn: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman

items.glossEn: disciple
items.defEn: a learner, i.e. pupil

items.glossEn: accept, + be amazed, assay, attain, bring, X when I call, catch, come on (X unto), + forget, have, hold, obtain, receive (X after), take (away, up)
items.defEn: while G138 (αἱρέομαι) is more violent, to seize or remove))

items.glossEn: [phrase] condemned, guilty, ungodly, wicked (man), that did wrong.
items.defEn: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person

items.glossEn: country, earth(-ly), ground, land, world
items.defEn: soil; by extension a region, or the solid part or the whole of the terrene globe (including the occupants in each application)

items.glossEn: [phrase] bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, ((faint), (tender-) heart(-ed), midst, mind, [idiom] unawares, understanding.
items.defEn: the heart (as the most interior organ);

items.glossEn: rod, staff, tribe.
items.defEn: a branch (as extending); figuratively, a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively, correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figurati

items.glossEn: accomplish, confirm, [phrase] consecrate, be at an end, be expired, be fenced, fill, fulfil, (be, become, [idiom] draw, give in, go) full(-ly, -ly set, tale), (over-) flow, fulness, furnish, gather (selves, together), presume, replenish, satisfy, set, space, take a (hand-) full, [phrase] have wholly.
items.defEn: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)

items.glossEn: answer
items.defEn: to conclude for oneself, i.e. (by implication) to respond; by Hebraism (compare H06030) to begin to speak (where an address is expected)

items.glossEn: cubit, [phrase] hundred (by exchange for H3967 (מֵאָה)), measure, post.
items.defEn: properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance)

items.glossEn: favour, good deed(-liness, -ness), kindly, (loving-) kindness, merciful (kindness), mercy, pity, reproach, wicked thing.
items.defEn: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty

items.glossEn: able, activity, ([phrase]) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host, might, power, riches, strength, strong, substance, train, ([phrase]) valiant(-ly), valour, virtuous(-ly), war, worthy(-ily).
items.defEn: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength

items.glossEn: believe(-r), commit (to trust), put in trust with
items.defEn: to have faith (in, upon, or with respect to, a person or thing), i.e. credit; by implication, to entrust (especially one's spiritual well-being to Christ)

items.glossEn: [idiom] be able to endure, [idiom] according as, [idiom] after, [idiom] coming, [idiom] follow, (broken-)foot(-ed, -stool), [idiom] great toe, [idiom] haunt, [idiom] journey, leg, [phrase] piss, [phrase] possession, time.
items.defEn: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda

items.glossEn: assurance, belief, believe, faith, fidelity
items.defEn: persuasion, i.e. credence; moral conviction (of religious truth, or the truthfulness of God or a religious teacher), especially reliance upon Christ for salvation; abstractly, cons

items.glossEn: border, bound, coast, [idiom] great, landmark, limit, quarter, space.
items.defEn: properly, a cord (as twisted), i.e. (by implication) a boundary; by extension the territory inclosed

items.glossEn: God (god), [idiom] goodly, [idiom] great, idol, might(-y one), power, strong. Compare names in '-el.'
items.defEn: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)

items.glossEn: babe, boy, child, damsel (from the margin), lad, servant, young (man).
items.defEn: (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age)

items.glossEn: bear the blame, cleanse, commit (sin), by fault, harm he hath done, loss, miss, (make) offend(-er), offer for sin, purge, purify (self), make reconciliation, (cause, make) sin(-ful, -ness), trespass.
items.defEn: properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn

items.glossEn: act, art, [phrase] bakemeat, business, deed, do(-ing), labor, thing made, ware of making, occupation, thing offered, operation, possession, [idiom] well, (handy-, needle-, net-) work(ing, -manship), wrought.
items.defEn: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property

items.glossEn: fault, iniquity, mischeif, punishment (of iniquity), sin.
items.defEn: perversity, i.e. (moral) evil

items.glossEn: [idiom] burn (incense), [idiom] earnestly, be male, (make) mention (of), be mindful, recount, record(-er), remember, make to be remembered, bring (call, come, keep, put) to (in) remembrance, [idiom] still, think on, [idiom] well.
items.defEn: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention;  to be male

items.glossEn: cast out, consume, destroy, disinherit, dispossess, drive(-ing) out, enjoy, expel, [idiom] without fail, (give to, leave for) inherit(-ance, -or) [phrase] magistrate, be (make) poor, come to poverty, (give to, make to) possess, get (have) in (take) possession, seize upon, succeed, [idiom] utterly.
items.defEn: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize, to rob, to inherit; also to expel, to impoverish, to ruin

items.glossEn: (bring in) abundance ([idiom] -antly), [phrase] archer (by mistake for H7232 (רָבַב)), be in authority, bring up, [idiom] continue, enlarge, excel, exceeding(-ly), be full of, (be, make) great(-er, -ly, [idiom] -ness), grow up, heap, increase, be long, (be, give, have, make, use) many (a time), (any, be, give, give the, have) more (in number), (ask, be, be so, gather, over, take, yield) much (greater, more), (make to) multiply, nourish, plenty(-eous), [idiom] process (of time), sore, store, thoroughly, very.
items.defEn: to increase (in whatever respect)

items.glossEn: [idiom] among, [idiom] before, bowels, [idiom] unto charge, [phrase] eat (up), [idiom] heart, [idiom] him, [idiom] in, inward ([idiom] -ly, part, -s, thought), midst, [phrase] out of, purtenance, [idiom] therein, [idiom] through, [idiom] within self.
items.defEn: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)

items.glossEn: ask, beg, beseech, desire, enquire, get, make inquisition, procure, (make) request, require, seek (for).
items.defEn: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after

items.glossEn: country, earth, ground, husband(-man) (-ry), land.
items.defEn: soil (from its general redness)

items.glossEn: describe, record, prescribe, subscribe, write(-ing, -ten).
items.defEn: to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe)

items.glossEn: heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare H5158 (נַחַל).
items.defEn: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion

items.glossEn: appointed (sign, time), (place of, solemn) assembly, congregation, (set, solemn) feast, (appointed, due) season, solemn(-ity), synogogue, (set) time (appointed).
items.defEn: properly, an appointment, i.e. a fixed time or season; specifically, a festival; conventionally ayear; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically

items.glossEn: allow, be aware (of), feel, (have) know(-ledge), perceived, be resolved, can speak, be sure, understand
items.defEn: to "know" (absolutely) in a great variety of applications and with many implications (as follow, with others not thus clearly expressed)

items.glossEn: wife, woman
items.defEn: a woman; specially, a wife

items.glossEn: come (forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad
items.defEn: to issue (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: dam, mother, [idiom] parting.
items.defEn: a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively (like father))

items.glossEn: law.
items.defEn: a precept or statute, especially the Decalogue or Pentateuch

items.glossEn: [idiom] assuredly, banquet, [idiom] certainly, drink(-er, -ing), drunk ([idiom] -ard), surely. (Prop. intensive of H8248 (שָׁקָה).)
items.defEn: to imbibe (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: Jehoshua, Jehoshuah, Joshua. Compare H1954 (הוֹשֵׁעַ), H3442 (יֵשׁוּעַ).
items.defEn: Jehoshua (i.e. Joshua), the Jewish leader

items.glossEn: fellow, husband, man, sir
items.defEn: a man (properly as an individual male)

items.glossEn: certain(-ty), confirm, direct, faithfulness, fashion, fasten, firm, be fitted, be fixed, frame, be meet, ordain, order, perfect, (make) preparation, prepare (self), provide, make provision, (be, make) ready, right, set (aright, fast, forth), be stable, (e-) stablish, stand, tarry, [idiom] very deed.
items.defEn: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative

items.glossEn: six(-teen, -teenth), sixth.
items.defEn: six (as an overplus  beyond five or the fingers of the hand); as ord. sixth

items.glossEn: commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, [idiom] surely.
items.defEn: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.

items.glossEn: army, band, battle, camp, company, drove, host, tents.
items.defEn: an encampment (of travellers or troops); hence, an army, whether literal (of soldiers) or figurative (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts)

items.glossEn: [phrase] afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.
items.defEn: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application

items.glossEn: ambassador, angel, king, messenger.
items.defEn: a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher)

items.glossEn: [idiom] at all, defend, deliver (self), escape, [idiom] without fail, part, pluck, preserve, recover, rescue, rid, save, spoil, strip, [idiom] surely, take (out).
items.defEn: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
